sections.title: The letter Em
paragraphs: The letter is called (Em) /ɛm/. Its main sound appears in (Mutter) /ˈmʊtɐ/, which means mother. This letter makes only one sound.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Close both lips gently together. Send the air out through your nose. Turn your voice on. Touch your throat to feel the buzz.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound you hear in (Sommer) /ˈzɔmɐ/. You say it the same way at the start, middle, or end.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: This sound is identical to the ordinary sound in mother. You will not find any pitfall with this sound.
